_comment: Board terrain per story quest. 'theme' selects the questboard prefab library the client loads (GameboardManager.RequestLibrary / GetBasePathForType take a themeName); 'todIndex' selects the time-of-day variant inside that theme's bundle. Verified against the shipped 9.2 asset bundles -- assets/assetpack/<theme>/<theme>_merged.assetbundle contains <theme>_timeofday_<N>_<render>.prefab. Four themes ship and each supports a different number of times of day, so todIndex must be validated per theme, not globally.
_arena_comment: Fight-background variety is OPT-IN per quest via "arena": {"vary": true}, and optionally "pool": [...] to draw from a chosen grouping instead of all five shipped arena levels. Quests without an "arena" key keep the previous behaviour: the global TFTF_ARENA_LEVEL / TFTF_ARENA_TOD, or the hardcoded chicago the custom-story paths used. All Story quests (1.1.1, 2.1.1, 2.2.1, 2.3.1, 2.3.2, 2.4.1) and the 1.1.2 challenge are opted in. The pick is seeded from quest id and encounter x coordinate rather than random_int on purpose: build_quest_begin / build_quest_detail are baked into a CRC-32 guarded payload, so a fresh roll per call would make every export a different blob and could show one arena on the map preview and another in the fight.

_shipped_arena_levels._note: Confirmed present in the 9.2 offline repack, which is not the same claim as 'all the game ever shipped' -- the original store APKs are ~103 MB and fetched most bundles on demand.
